system.description: You move a short distance and make a melee attack to grab a foe of your size or smaller. (Unlike a normal situation of taking an action and moving a short distance, this doesn't hinder your tasks.) A successful attack means you grab the foe and bring it to a halt if it was moving (this can be treated as a tackle, if appropriate). Action.
